COD.rationale: Identified content (red set) and an organization/access attribute (origin) are both explicitly reported for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No text links attention/allocation to a content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Content sets (color-labeled coordinate lists) are explicitly identified.

D.rationale: The report separates identified content (color coordinate set) from a presentation/access/status attribute (origin).

O.rationale: An origin/presentation attribute is explicitly reported for the content (how it is represented/accessed).
